jobs.description:
Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.

Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

Our client is an international organisation headquartered in Brussels, bringing together members and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a fast-paced and multicultural environment, the organisation is seeking an Administration Officer to support its administrative, financial and office management activities and help ensure the efficient running of its operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage shared mailboxes and handle day-to-day business correspondence.
• Process invoices and maintain accurate supplier and financial records.
• Support payment processing, budget tracking and expense administration.
• Coordinate with external finance partners and maintain relevant documentation.
• Oversee recurring fees, contributions and other incoming payments.
• Track contracts, renewals, deadlines and purchasing activities.
• Prepare administrative and financial reports, dashboards and internal tracking files.
• Ensure project documentation, agreements and supporting records are complete and up to date.
• Assist with the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate office facilities, suppliers, equipment and service providers.
• Support employee onboarding and offboarding administration.
• Maintain efficient filing systems and contribute to process improvements.
• Provide broader administrative and operational support as needed.

A successful Project Officer should have:

• Previous experience in administration, operations support, office coordination or a similar role.
• Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
• Able to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of internal and external stakeholders.

Join a dynamic and fast-growing international company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and ambition are at the heart of everything. You'll have the opportunity to build a global network, make a real impact, and accelerate your career in an inspiring environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
• Develop and manage your own client portfolio.
• Identify and approach new business opportunities.
• Understand clients' needs and provide tailored solutions.
• Conduct market research and monitor industry trends.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Represent the company during meetings, events, and client visits.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in French or Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Ambitious, energetic, and driven by results.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Not afraid of client contact or commercial challenges.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive attitude.
• Eager to learn and build a successful career in sales and account management.

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?

• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Data Analyst and Process Optimization Coordinator
jobs.description:
The company operates in the life science sector and is based in Machelen.

Jobomschrijving

As a Commercial Data Analyst and Process Optimization Coordinator your responsibilities are:

• Maintain and update commercial systems to ensure data accuracy and reliability
• Support the customer service department with system-related inquiries and troubleshooting
• Monitor system performance and coordinate with IT teams for improvements
• Prepare and generate reports to provide insights for business decisions
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless workflow integration
• Train staff on system functionalities and updates when required
• Manage user access and permissions within the commercial system
• Analyze sales results
• Translate Data into specific Insights

As Commercial Data Analyst and Process Optimization Coordinator you have following profile:

• You are a SAP Key user
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: you understand data and translate it into sales actions
• You master Excel
• Knowledge of customer service processes and systems
• Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy
• Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
• Fluency in Dutch, English and French

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. The company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

Currently in a phase of significant growth, they are looking for motivated and dedicated team members to join their mission.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
• Supporting transitions between production zones
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

Place of Employment - Machelen

Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.

Your Role:

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 

Key Responsibilities:

Air Freight Administration

• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities. 
Customer Service

• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected. 
Compliance & Operational Excellence

• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required. 

Your Profile:

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.

Requirements

• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
Proactive and able to work independently. 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.

• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues.
Personal Qualities

• Customer-focused and service-minded.
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Comptable AP Team leader English and French
jobs.description:
Our client is an international company located in Liege.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Team Leader Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
• Good communication skills for liaising with vendors and internal teams.

jobs.occupation: Freelance Accountant and Internal Control Consultant
jobs.description:
Our client is a construction company.

Jobomschrijving

Accounting

• Manage day-to-day accounting activities for one or several entities.
• Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual closings.
• Perform balance sheet reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of accounting records.
• Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger postings.
• Prepare VAT declarations and support other tax compliance obligations.
• Assist in the preparation of statutory accounts and audit files.
• Coordinate with external auditors, accountants and tax advisors.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian accounting standards and company policies.

Internal Control

• Assess and document existing financial and operational processes.
• Identify control weaknesses and propose pragmatic improvement actions.
• Ensure proper segregation of duties and compliance with internal procedures.
• Review approval workflows, authorizations and financial governance processes.
• Support the implementation and monitoring of internal control frameworks.
• Perform periodic control testing and follow-up on remediation actions.
• Participate in risk assessments and recommend mitigating measures.
• Support finance leadership in strengthening audit readiness and compliance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting combined with exposure to internal control, audit or compliance activities.
• Experience from construction, real estate or architect companies (must have).
• French and English.

jobs.occupation: Finance Business Partner - Engineering - South of Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is an international leader in the technical sector, providing solutions for clients worldwide. They are expanding their specialized field of activities and need some additional support for their local finance team in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

In this role you will have the following responsibilities:

• Partner with sales teams to structure financing solutions for strategic deals.
• Advise clients on funding options, business cases and investment projects.
• Build relationships with banks, insurers and other financial partners.
• Develop innovative financial products that support business growth.
• Assess financial risks and provide recommendations to management.

The successful candidate matches the following criteria:

• Fluent in French and English, Dutch is an asset

We're looking for an IT Coordinator to play a key role in a fast-evolving Benelux environment. You'll combine hands-on IT expertise with project leadership, supporting critical business systems while driving strategic initiatives across ERP, e-commerce, cloud, and business applications.

Our client is a leading international group active in industrial solutions. Operating in a dynamic Benelux environment, they combine global standards with local agility. • Manage the full lifecycle of client files, from onboarding to closure.

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
